thread:
rebecca-rm: Heads up — release v3.7.2 can't promote. Deploy bot reports promotion blocked; staging promotion job queued >30m. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: staging-promo-2981 queued >1800s. Last attempt failed on cache restore. JobID=build-2981. Logs: `ERROR: cache restore timeout for shard s3://redwood-ci/cache/qt-2981 (x-req-id=0a1b2c)`

sam-ci: I can confirm — integration-test-longtask-45 is holding a runner for ~45m and hasn't progressed. Likely a flaky loop.

lee-eng: Can we abort that job? It's blocking the canary. I can rerun it in a patched branch with a timeout fix.

sam-ci: Abort is possible but FYI aborting won't immediately free the artifact promotion; deploy-bot waits for artifact upload completion. Alternative: force promote by pinning the artifact digest. @rebecca-rm any preference?

rebecca-rm: Prefer to avoid force-promote unless necessary — we want a clean canary. Change window closes in ~1h though. If we must force, pin to digest and document it in release notes.

maria-ops: Seeing spike in ephemeral runner evictions in pool-eu-west; autoscaler is slow due to quota. I'll scale +2 now (may take 5-7m to be ready).

deploy-bot: Manual promote command: `/deploy promote --artifact=sha256:abcd1234 --force --note="pin due to CI queue"` (requires approver).

lee-eng: If we force-promote, add a canary health check and an auto-rollback (30m) so we don't silently ship bad behavior. I can add the health-check route.

rebecca-rm: Proposed plan: 1) attempt to abort longtest and rerun with timeout fix; 2) scale runners; 3) wait 20m — if still blocked, force-promote pinned digest with rollback guard. Who will approve the force?

sam-ci: I'll monitor. If queue not cleared in 20m I'll post for approval and run the promote command.

rebecca-rm: @maria-ops please confirm when scaling is done. Also open a bug for the flaky test and move it to slow-tests quarantine.

maria-ops: Scaling initiated — 3 new runners requested. Eviction rate dropping, will confirm in ~3m.

deploy-bot: Update: build-2981 still queued; artifact upload not started. job_queue_size=18. next_check=30s.

lee-eng: I aborted integration-test-longtask-45 and kicked a rerun as build-2982 with the timeout patch (PR #4321).

sam-ci: Rerun started for build-2982. ETA ~12m.

deploy-bot: promotion-unblock-check: artifact build-2982 upload started. status=uploading. ETA ~2m.

rebecca-rm: Good — hold off on force-promote for now. Keep me posted. I'll add a short note to the release draft: 'promotion delayed due to CI runner queue'.

sam-ci: Build-2982 uploaded, artifact hash=sha256:abcd1234. Promoting to staging now.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded: v3.7.2 -> staging. Canary rollout scheduled; watchers: rebecca-rm, lee-eng, sam-ci. :tada:

rebecca-rm: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: create ticket for the flaky test, add autoscaler alert for runner evictions, and document emergency promote steps + pinning guidance in the runbook.
